Snap earlier this year in June publicly revealed the design of its consumer-grade Spectacles glasses, and has now announced that the glasses are available for pre-order starting today, and will come with a brand-new 5G charging case. At the same time, the company has launched a proactive AI agent called Specs Intelligence. Despite the name, it can be used on iPhone and Mac whether or not you've bought the glasses.

Cellular Specs, launched in partnership with Verizon

Snap today announced that it will launch a cellular charging case for Snap Specs, allowing you to use your Specs even when you're away from home. The case can be purchased separately, or together with the glasses for an additional $200, or $2,395.

For cellular network service on Specs, Verizon customers pay $10 per month, while customers of other carriers pay $20. Overseas, France's Orange and the UK's EE will also offer cellular plans for Specs.

Specs is expected to ship to consumers later this fall as scheduled, though an exact date has yet to be determined. However, Snap will open an experience zone at the Westfield Century City in Los Angeles starting October 1, allowing eager customers to try it out early. Verizon stores will also offer try-on experiences later.

You can pre-order Specs today with a $200 refundable deposit by clicking here.

Specs Intelligence

Snap has also joined the battlefield of personal AI agents, launching the Specs Intelligence application for iPhone and Mac. Despite the name, you don't need to own Specs glasses to use it—but it works even more seamlessly when paired with Specs. Here's the company's introduction to the service:

It will gradually build an understanding of your goals, priorities, relationships and daily routines through the apps and tools you choose to connect, helping you focus on what's important right now while steadily advancing your long-term goals. SPECS Intelligence is designed not to wait until you speak first, but to anticipate when you need help and push relevant information and recommendations to you at the right moment. On SPECS AR glasses, it extends this personalised information into the real world, presenting relevant content directly before your eyes.

The application is open for its official website waitlist starting today.
